text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up for the onboarding packet to Meridian Health — we need to finalize how we present SLA evidence. Quick q's: 1) show p95 or p99 in the customer-facing page? 2) do they want raw ledger CSV or a one-page PDF summary? @Rafael @Priya

Rafael Gomez: Customer docs = p95. Keep it simple. Internally keep p99 for the credit math. CSV for the ledger, customers can import into their dashboards.

Priya Nair: CSV + a one-page PDF summary is my vote (PDF for execs, CSV for analysts). Also call out the measurement window (14d vs 30d) in the header. Meridian usually asks for 14d rolling.

Aisha Khan: Good call on 14d for Meridian. So we do: PDF summary (p95, 14d rolling, timezone PST) + CSV ledger (detailed, header row).

Marcos Silva: For automation, run the export like this from the infra host:

```
rbx-observability export --customer meridian --range 14d --tz America/Los_Angeles --format csv --include-maintenance > meridian-uptime-14d.csv
zip meridian-sla-bundle-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).zip meridian-uptime-14d.csv sla-summary.pdf audit-log.json
```

Marcos Silva: Note: include the maintenance audit-log so customers can see scheduled windows.

Aisha Khan: Can we also include a short appendix that maps uptime/latency to credits? The account team wants something concise for renewal talks.

Rafael Gomez: Yeah — small table in the appendix. Suggested tiers for this customer (feel free to tweak):

```
Metric         | Window | Credit
uptime >= 99.9 | 14d    | 0%
uptime 99.5-99.9 | 14d | 3%
avg p95 latency < 350ms | 14d | 0%
p95 latency 350-600ms  | 14d | 5%
```

Priya Nair: Add a sentence about expected onboarding noise: first 48 hours can show transient latency spikes due to model warmup and tracing. That helps set expectations during renewal conversations.

Aisha Khan: I'll draft the appendix and the PDF blurb. Once the bundle is uploaded I'll ping the AE to attach it to the renewal playbook.

ops-bot: automated: upload complete -> /shared/meridian/onboarding/sla_packages/meridian-sla-bundle-20240402.zip :white_check_mark:

Rafael Gomez: Thx. @Aisha include a link to the dashboard view and the export command in the bundle README so customers can reproduce.

Aisha Khan: Will do. Closing the thread after I attach the README and send to the AE. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
